sourceBaseline: cc2873b5 (pushed dev commit of Fast Checks run 40187427911)
originalFailure: Fast Checks run 40187427911, job 121151078654 'Agent Tools Shard 2' (ubuntu-latest x86_64, CPython 3.12.15, non-root runner): outcome failure after 3.6 s. The shard step hit its 50-minute timeout before unittest printed tracebacks, so only the public per-test event below survives.
runnerImageEvidence: actions/runner-images images/ubuntu/scripts/build/configure-limits.sh sets '* hard nofile 65536' and DefaultLimitNOFILE=65536, so the case's descriptor-limit scenario (b) runs instead of skipping (it skips only below an 8300 hard limit).
confirmedCause: Every scenario's holders lived until the whole case ended (Tree cleanup only). On the runner scenario (b) really started its 8200-descriptor holder. readiness_windows_creator_prevm_recovery._actor_census returns actor_descriptor_limit as soon as any scanned same-account process holds more than 8192 descriptors, so every later scan in the case - the cwd-only (c), map-only (d) and zombie (e) scenarios - was refused for scenario (b)'s still-live holder instead of observing its own holder: (c) and (d) got actor_descriptor_limit instead of actor_reference_present and (e) was refused instead of proven. Hosts whose descriptor hard limit is below 8300 skip (b) and passed, which is why it was green before. Derived from the exact census source, the runner image limits and the 3.6 s outcome; the lost tracebacks could not be read.
fix: Each scenario now ends its own holders (Tree.cleanup in a finally) before the next scenario starts, and every scenario assertion reports the proof result, the newest observer receipts, the census culprit's pid and command line, the scenario's children and the descriptor limit on failure. The writer readiness_windows_creator_prevm_recovery.py and its embedded census are unchanged.
controlledRegression: agent_tools.tests.test_prevm_census_scenario_lifetime runs the exact embedded census over the module's procfs double on every host: a live earlier holder above 8192 descriptors refuses a later cwd-only holder's scan with actor_descriptor_limit naming that earlier pid; once ended, the later scan sees only its own reference. On Linux (non-root, hard limit at least 8300) it runs the original case of this whole beforeimage and of the current module on the real procfs.
failingEvidence: Unfixed: on the Linux runner the beforeimage case's failures all name actor_descriptor_limit. This macOS host skips the real-procfs half (Linux /proc only).
passingEvidence: Fixed: the faked-procfs mechanism half passes on this host; the current real-procfs case is expected to pass on the next Linux Fast Checks run.
routineSuite: agent_tools.tests.test_prevm_census_scenario_lifetime runs in the affected agent-test stage of the managed pre-push tier and the Fast Checks agent shards whenever the selector reaches it, including changes to test_windows_creator_prevm_refusal_recovery.py, readiness_windows_creator_prevm_recovery.py, this beforeimage or this provenance.
nativeEvidenceLimit: Hosted-runner test-harness outcome only; no root census, libvirt, VM or creator native behavior is involved or claimed. Only the next Linux Fast Checks run can show the real-procfs RED/GREEN; this macOS host proves only the census mechanism over the procfs double.
